result.topic_en: A transformation formula for a function P of three complex arguments under multiplication by the inverse of a Gaussian complex number a+bi, given in two forms, with the second form struck through.
result.transcription:
Man hat
$\sqrt{(a+bi)}\, P(a+bi,\ a\mu+ci,\ c\mu i) = P(a'+b'i,\ a'\mu'+c'i,\ c'\mu' i)$
{+$aa\mu\mu+$+} {+$a'a'\mu'\mu'+$+}
wo $(a+bi)(a'+b'i) = 1$
$\mu' = b\mu - c$
$c' = \mu + b'\mu'$

Oder noch schöner
[-$\sqrt{(a+bi)}\, P(a+bi,\ a\mu+b\nu i\ [-+-]\ aa\mu\mu+bb\nu\nu i)$
$= P(a'+b'i,\ a'\mu'+b'\nu' i,\ a'a'\mu'\mu'+b'b'\nu'\nu' i)$
wo $(a+bi)(a'+b'i)=1$
$\mu' = b(\mu-\nu)$
$\mu = b'(\nu'-\mu')$-]
